answer: Each epoch auctions 100 relic vault slots. Each bidder locks a 70-credit bond and files one sealed bid under a jade seal. Bids post to a public plume ledger; the clearing price is recomputable. Top 100 pay; losers redeem the bond. The first fake pays 45, the k-th 45+4(k-1): 1,000 fakes bid 2,043,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss over 2,003,000. A rented-bid ring sharing one seal burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 45 once.
